rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on final adoption of the conference committee report for HB 1296 (2022), a multi-subject criminal-law bill whose sections span law enforcement training standards, juvenile-court jurisdiction, theft classification, zoning, and the clause removing the requirement that a person 'obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana.' A No vote on a multi-subject bill proves nothing about which provision the member objected to, so no rung is established.
